units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 46a:20">Ab. Zar. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>דמינכרא זְקִיפָתָהּ</he> the erection of which is noticeable.
<cite ref="Sukkah 43b:8">Succ. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>דלמא בז׳</he> perhaps the proper ceremony consists in posting it (by the side of the altar).—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 24a">M. Kat. 24ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>זְקִיפַת המטה</he> the putting up of the couch (on the Sabbath during mourning), opp. <cite ref="K01010"><he>כְּפִיָּיה</he></cite>.
